thread:
alex_weaver: heads up — during the rolling BMC firmware push in us-west-2 ~20 G5 nodes came back in a weird state: Secure Boot got toggled ON and OOB TLS certs are failing. kernels are dropping with UEFI secure boot violations and consoles show TLS handshake errors. I opened the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/bmc-firmware-rollback :wave:

deploy-bot: started job fw-roll-2026-03-bmc-usw2 targeting racks: rack-g5-12..15, rack-g5-19..21 :gear:

maria_nguyen: ack. which specific racks/nodes? any DHCP or iPXE evidence?

alex_weaver: affected racks are rack-g5-12..15 and rack-g5-19..21. iPXE cached images allowed 6 nodes to boot, but most drop with: "UEFI: Secure Boot violation - kernel image rejected". BMC web UI returns "TLS: certificate verify failed" when curling https://<bmc-ip>.
jordan_kim: can we flip the secure boot flag remotely or at least read it? vendor has a vendor-tool but ipmitool raw might work. try: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U $USER -P $PASS raw 0x30 0x70 0x0c 0x00` to query secureboot state (vendor-specific).

alex_weaver: used vendor CLI: `redwood-bmcctl status --host 10.2.3.45` returned:
```
BMC: g5-12-03
secure_boot: enabled
oob_tls_state: cert-mismatch
last_fw: 2026-03-17T02:45Z
```
maria_nguyen: plan A: emergency rollback to previous BMC image for affected racks. Plan B: if rollback fails, temporarily disable secure boot via OOB command and quarantine nodes. Need approval from SRE/security for disabling SB. @sre-oncall please advise.
sre-oncall: +1 for targeted rollback on the affected racks. Disabling secure boot temporarily OK if nodes are quarantined and keys rotated asap. Authorize rollback and short-term disable where needed.
infra-bot: created incident INC-2026-345, linked runbook https://redwood.internal/runbooks/bmc-firmware-rollback, assigned to alex_weaver and jordan_kim.

alex_weaver: starting rollback on rack-g5-12..15, staggered by 5min per host to keep spares available. command: 
```
redwood-deploy rollback --fw bmc-2026-02-12 --hosts @rack-g5-12..15 --oob-mode serial
```
jordan_kim: monitoring scheduler — seeing allocation backpressure in us-west-2 because we drained ~12 nodes. please throttle new placements (added soft drain tag).
maria_nguyen: added temp policy: scheduler tag `oob-maintenance` so autoscaler and batch jobs avoid these racks.
alex_weaver: rollback completed for rack-g5-12..15. Verified secure_boot toggled off during maintenance and re-enabled after successful image boot on 9/10 nodes. 2 nodes still show cert-mismatch, vendor-support on call now.
vendor-support: we're investigating a regression in the 2026-03 BMC image that can flip the SB bit when TLS handshake fails during cert rotation. collecting BMC logs now (please provide /var/log/bmc_fw.log).
deploy-bot: job fw-roll-2026-03-bmc-usw2 COMPLETE with 84% automated success, 16% manual intervention required (rollback/disable).
sre-oncall: please do a postmortem with timeline + mitigation: vendor gating on canary racks, extend canary time to 2 hours, add pre-check to validate cert chain and secureboot flag before staging next batch. Also note cost impact: losing 12 nodes for ~6 hours bumped on-demand usage — rough estimate +$5k for the window.
alex_weaver: will file postmortem INC-2026-345/pm and attach logs + commands used. Quick notes saved to the runbook: add pre-flight `bmcctl verify-cert --host <host>` and `bmcctl read-secureboot --host <host>`.
maria_nguyen: thanks — need a short customer-facing blurb for infra-status? minimal, say: "We experienced an out-of-band firmware rollout issue in us-west-2 affecting node reboots; most nodes recovered after rollback; follow-up postmortem forthcoming." :thumbsup:
